title: Mass of B
description: Essential: Correctly calculates m = 3 kg from force balance on ball B using tension symmetry and geometry.

title: Friction force magnitude
description: Essential: Correctly determines f = 10 N from horizontal force balance on block C.

title: Normal force on C
description: Important: Correctly computes normal force N from vertical force balance on block C, accounting for tension's vertical component.

title: Friction coefficient
description: Essential: Correctly calculates μ = f/N, yielding μ = 2√3/9 ≈ 0.385.

title: Tension relationships
description: Important: Recognizes equal tensions in ribbon segments from A to B and from B to C due to smooth pulleys and equilibrium.

title: Force balance on B
description: Important: Applies vector force balance on ball B with correct 60° geometry to relate tensions to m·g.

title: Horizontal balance on C
description: Important: Sets up horizontal equilibrium for block C including tension component, friction, and D's weight.

title: Sign error in friction
description: Pitfall: Assigns wrong direction to friction force (e.g., opposing wrong motion tendency) in C's equilibrium.

title: Angle misuse
description: Pitfall: Uses incorrect angles (e.g., 30° vs 60°) when resolving tension components on B or C.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Maintains consistent units (kg, N) and uses g = 10 m/s² correctly throughout.
